exact_title: Comparative effectiveness of GLP-1 receptor agonists on glycaemic control, body weight, and lipid profile for type 2 diabetes: systematic review and network meta-analysis
source_type: systematic review and frequentist network meta-analysis
appendices_or_supplements: Appendix 6: Secondary outcome network maps and forest plots
Appendix 7: SUCRA and cumulative probability plots
Appendix 16: Single versus dual/triple agonist analyses
Appendix 17: Adverse events by dose versus placebo

supplement_figure_families.representation: reconciled by appendix-family structured blocks; primary/safety numerical outputs additionally atomized

supplement_table_occurrences.representation: reconciled by appendix-family structured blocks; league-table and key subgroup values summarized/atomized

visual_strategy.structured_blocks: All 8 main figures; all 17 appendix families; supplement figure/table families grouped by semantic appendix.
visual_strategy.embedded_crops_or_screenshots: None in final HTML; figures were visually inspected during QA and faithfully represented in structured text.
visual_strategy.omitted_with_reason: No main-text figure omitted. Raw row-by-row reproduction of every supplement league-table cell is omitted from SEA because it is highly duplicative; the appendix families remain explicitly reconciled and load-bearing values are preserved.

coverage_decision: Full main article plus all 17 supplied supplementary appendices included in mapping and appraisal.
omissions: No primary source outside the supplied publication packet was independently re-read; bibliography entries are queued for separate review.
source_integrity_flags: Appendix 8 title states 75 trials while the main article reports 76 trials in final quantitative synthesis.
Table S4 label is reused for an Embase search strategy and for a risk-of-bias table.
Results prose says all 15 GLP-1RAs significantly reduced fasting blood glucose, while Figure 5 displays 14 agents and omits ITCA 650.
Main Figure 7 reports lixisenatide body-weight MD -0.62 kg (95% CI -1.51 to 0.87), while Supplementary Table S8.3 reports -0.32 kg with the same CI.
